$comment: Two things that must not pass as a fully qualified accountant. 'Part-qualified ACCA' is recorded with status part_qualified and stays out of certifications, so no requirement for ACCA or an equivalent is met. AAT is fully held and is in certifications, but it sits in the technician group, not the CPA-level one. The summary names both in one sentence: only the ACCA is part-qualified.
